value.rationale: Recent work characterizes qualitative boundedness/compactness/Hilbert–Schmidt membership of the exact radial-power Fock operator class. The new complete asymptotic singular-value count computes the normalized number of degrees needed for optimal finite-rank approximation as strict dilations approach the unbounded polynomial multiplier. Its two-branch Lambert profile captures both sides of a genuine spectral maximum; it simultaneously yields sharp scaling constants in every Schatten ideal including the quasi-Banach range. Universality under arbitrary lower-order polynomial perturbations is structural and directly useful for approximation costs, not merely a restatement of compactness.
